definition: Wisdom as measured: seeing situations from many sides, with reflective distance and compassion.
neighbors: Intellectual Humility · Actively Open-Minded Thinking · Compassion (other column)
taxonomy: VIA Perspective (Wisdom) · Ardelt Three-Dimensional Wisdom Scale · Webster SAWS

Contested: Glück 2013 finds the five measures only partly converge; Grossmann argues wisdom is state/context-dependent — the L-row uses the 3D-WS self-report trait reading (cognitive + reflective + affective).
